title: Envelope of a request, contract version 1
description: The fields of a write's envelope that a caller sends through an exposed surface (PRD 6.1): the idempotency key, the correlation id, the wait level, whether it is a dry run, whom the actor acts for and the provenance of agents and ingestion. The actor, the surface and the issuer kind are never part of it: the surface takes them from the transport. The reason is part of the command. Every key but idempotency_key may be left out and then has its default. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Contracts\Envelope\RequestEnvelope, and the generated codec EnvelopeCodecV1 reads it and writes its canonical JSON: every key, sorted, no whitespace.

correlation_id.description: The id that ties the call together across HTTP, MCP, CLI, jobs and sidecars, such as a trace id: 1 to 128 visible ASCII characters. When it is null the surface makes one.

dry_run.description: Whether to compute the plan, the blast radius and the receipt without committing.

idempotency_key.description: The caller's idempotency key: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, compared exactly. The same key with the same command gives the first call's result; with another command it is refused with idempotency_conflict.

on_behalf_of.description: Whom the actor acts for, in order, from the principal it acts for directly to the person at the end of the chain, each an actor id, a UUIDv7. An actor appears at most once, and never the actor itself.

provenance.description: Where the command's content came from, for agents and ingestion (PRD 5.5). A person's command has none.

wait_level.description: How long to wait before the call returns (PRD 8.4): commit, origin, edge, verified or propagated.

line.description: Text of UTF-8 without control characters.

model.description: The model the content came from and its version, each 1 to 255 bytes of UTF-8 without control characters.

parameter.description: One parameter the model ran with, such as temperature and 0.2, each 1 to 255 bytes of UTF-8 without control characters.

provenance.description: The model, its parameters, a reference to the prompt and the sources. Parameters and a prompt need a model.

model.description: The model, or null when the content did not come from one.

parameters.description: The parameters the model ran with, each name at most once. They are kept sorted by name.

prompt.description: A reference to the prompt, 1 to 1024 bytes of UTF-8 without control characters, or null. The prompt itself is stored as classified content.

sources.description: The sources used, such as a URL or a feed's object id, each 1 to 2048 bytes of UTF-8 without control characters and at most once, in order.
